steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 60; S.coins = 20000; S.pearls = 200; ['crucian','perch','rudd','tench','bream','carp','goldcarp','trout','pike','clown','tang','swordfish'].forEach(id => { const f = FB.fishById[id]; S.album[id] = { n: 2, best: Math.round(f.w[0] + (f.w[1]-f.w[0])*0.5) }; }); S.stats.bestId = 'swordfish'; S.stats.bestG = 80000; S.trophies.push({ idx: 140, rank: 3, kind: 'silver' }, { idx: 142, rank: 15, kind: 'top20' }); FB.hud.update();

steps.name: посадить рыб
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn') && document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); const A = FB.aqua; ['carp','clown','pike'].forEach(id => A.addFish(id)); A.buySlot(); A.buySlot(); A.addFish('goldcarp'); A.addFish('tang'); A.buyDecor('stones'); A.buyDecor('chest'); A.buyDecor('castle'); A.buyDecor('coral'); FB.ui.refresh();
